    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
    Adds validated UTF-8 text persistence to an in-memory repository.
    CommunityService
    Derives undirected communities from the current user and friendship repositories.
    ConsoleUI
    Runs a text menu on standard input and output, delegating operations to services.
    Event
    Placeholder for a future event model.
    Friendship
    Represents an undirected friendship with a normalized ID pair and a non-null local creation date-time.
    FriendshipDbRepository
    Placeholder for friendship database persistence.
    FriendshipFileRepository
    Persists friendships as id1;id2;createdAt lines, with normalized IDs and an ISO local date-time.
    FriendshipId
    Identifies an unordered pair of distinct positive user IDs.
    FriendshipRepository
    Repository specialization for friendships identified by normalized user pairs.
    FriendshipService
    Constructs normalized friendships, checks participating users on insertion, and delegates storage and deletion to the friendship repository.
    FriendshipValidator
    Checks that a friendship is non-null and both users exist in the supplied repository at validation time.
    HasId<ID>
    Exposes an entity identifier without imposing validation or uniqueness rules.
    InMemoryFriendshipRepository
    A friendship repository with the reference-storage behavior of InMemoryRepository.
    InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
    Stores entity references in a map without running a domain validator.
    InMemoryUserRepository
    A user repository with the reference-storage behavior of InMemoryRepository.
    Main
    Application entry point that creates configured repositories, validators, services and the console interface.
    Message
    Placeholder for a future message model.
    Page
    Placeholder for a future page model.
    Repository<ID,E>
    Provides access to entities by identifier.
    RepositoryException
    Reports a repository or configuration I/O failure while preserving its cause.
    RepositoryFactory
    Selects repository implementations from src/main/resources/config.properties relative to the working directory.
    RepositoryType
    Storage choices accepted, with exactly this capitalization, by the factory.
    UI
    Entry contract for running an application's user interface.
    User
    Holds a user's identifier and names exactly as supplied, without validation or trimming.
    UserDbRepository
    Placeholder for user database persistence.
    UserFileRepository
    Persists users as id;firstName;lastName lines using the loading and rewrite behavior of AbstractFileRepository.
    UserRepository
    Repository specialization for users identified by Long values.
    UserService
    Validates user insertion and coordinates user deletion with friendship cleanup.
    UserValidator
    Validates user IDs and names without modifying the user.
    ValidationException
    Reports an entity validation failure independently of repository argument errors.
    Validator<T>
    Checks entities against the rules defined by a concrete validator.
